rules: Retain the original long entry expression, source-native EMA20/EMA50 and population standard deviation, original next-open entry identity and seven-symbol universe.
Do not exit early before the original twelve completed four-hour holding bars.

For the conditional child only, suspend the scheduled H12 timeout pending the completed H12 source receipt. This latency is a real difference from the fixed-time control and must be charged and evaluated by A.
At the actual decision time, native EMA20 greater than EMA50 yields continuation intent; equality or lower yields exit intent requiring a later independent fill witness.
Use only completed OHLC prefixes actually available and received by the decision time. Do not backdate a same-close or same-boundary next-open fill.
After an observed post-H12 trend loss, do not resume the extension without resolving that exit. Keep occupancy reserved until the existing owner confirms the fill.
No additional hold cap, SL/TP, ATR line, numerical parameter, symbol/month filter, or simultaneous early-failure axis is introduced.
An open position at the end of the supplied partition is censored, never liquidated synthetically for favorable accounting.
reviewed_six_cohort: OBSERVED_COHORT.json is immutable diagnostic evidence only; all six rows and losing members preserved. Never supplied as policy features.

history_separation.original: Stage3 pinned original39/reviewed26; inspected, never untouched OOS
history_separation.separate_dev: No actual eligible DEV archive or window selected. Conditional API requires a separately pinned source contract, fixed native warmup and end no later than original2026-08-30 boundary.
history_separation.fresh: No new fresh/OOS clock opened; no credit transferred.

comparison.account_NAV_and_DD: null unless separately measured; trade-bps is not account DD
comparison.rejection: Non-positive child-minus-parent Net2 improvement => REJECT_NO_COST2_IMPROVEMENT. Positive improvement still requires A review of PF, DD, streak, winner loss, timing/funding and unfinished positions; never automatic PASS.

next_axis.purpose: Test a distinct causal condition for loss streak/simultaneous-loss reduction only after the runner axis is resolved.
next_axis.prepared_now: Comparison code groups simultaneous exits and reports loss cohorts; no new loss filter selected from the reviewed outcomes.
